chunks: Jaʿfar ibn Ismāʿīl, al-Munqarī, Kufan. Ḥumayd ibn Ziyād and Ibn Ribāḥ narrated from him.

key_terms.الْمُنْقَرِيُّ: Al-Munqari (a nisba indicating lineage or tribe)
key_terms.غَالِيًا: Ghali (one who exaggerates, particularly in the beliefs of the Imams)

ai.seo_question: Who is Ja'far ibn Isma'il al-Munqari and what is his status in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This biographical entry describes Jaʿfar ibn Ismāʿīl al-Munqarī, a Kufan narrator. It notes that Ḥumayd ibn Ziyād and Ibn Ribāḥ narrated from him, characterizing him as a ghālī (exaggerator in religious matters) and a liar.
